long_biography.plain_text:
On an Asahi Beverages distribution centre project, Scott Haggarty worked with Stramit's technical team to select the roof and wall cladding. Lightweight products helped meet the installation requirements, while the chosen roof sheeting offered additional water-carrying capacity on a low-pitched roof. Stramit also provided advice during design and arranged production and delivery around the construction schedule.

His family's business later passed daily management to another generation. In 2023, his son Harry became general manager after five years with the group, allowing Haggarty to step back and concentrate on new business ventures.
